tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List the Slack workspace's public channels that are not archived, one page of at most 100, with whether the bot is a member. Read-only.

cursor.description: The next page's cursor from an earlier answer (optional).

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Read one public Slack channel's messages, newest first, one page of at most 100. Only a channel the bot has joined can be read. Read-only.

channel.description: The channel's id, as slack_list_channels gives it.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Slack timestamp (optional).

latest.description: Only messages before this Slack timestamp (optional).

cursor.description: The next page's cursor from an earlier answer (optional).
